{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out sentinel values (-1) in customer_age
df_valid_age = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age on valid data
mean_age = df_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Valid age data count: {len(df_valid_age)}")
print(f"Mean age (valid only): {mean_age}")"}
